name: website-templater
description: Metadata-driven website templating engine: Metadata → Modifier → Nunjucks → TSX → React/Vite → Static Website

scripts.dev: npm run generate && cd dist/site && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run generate && cd dist/site && npm install && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run generate && cd dist/site && npm install && npm run preview
